source.summary: Prepare the owned form, deploy its source, and retain the actual submission and receiving results.

plan.title: Form commissioning
plan.preserved: Keep the existing website, CMS, editable source and its owner’s account.
plan.route: Owned website form → configured Formward submission inbox → confirmed notification recipient.
steps: Record the actual website, form fields and recipient. Keep the current editable source and rollback copy.
Select or create the form in the owner’s Formward account. Configure its allowed website origins and actual notification recipient.
Confirm the notification recipient in the provider dashboard when required. Record the account’s consent and privacy settings.
Enter the actual endpoint, website origin, success path, recipient and field definitions in this workbench.
Save the complete working kit and deploy the generated form or fragment within the existing website.
Operate the rendered form on the actual website, receive its complete endpoint response and submission identifier, and inspect the destination mailbox.
Retain the actual receiving observations, full editable source, complete working record and rollback instructions for the owner.
plan.demonstration: Use the owner’s authorized sample values for a real submission. The local preview is inert. Record the actual response and mailbox result separately.
plan.scope: The website and provider account remain owned by their operator. This workbench prepares source and retains commissioning work; it does not provision the account or change its notification settings.
plan.qualification: Choose the actual delivery scope and website integration before deployment.
plan.privacy_map: Record the real purpose, fields, recipient, retention, consent requirements and privacy notice for this form.
